checklist: Verify the displayed case identifier, provenance, and baseline/candidate digests before reviewing semantics.
Inspect the exact baseline and candidate Claude Code project-settings artifacts, the plain source diff, and only the frozen source-documentation references supplied with the case.
Identify changes to permissions.defaultMode, permissions.allow, permissions.ask, permissions.deny, and any documented source semantics that materially affect the frozen authorization-review scope.

Determine whether the change establishes authorization widening or approval-boundary weakening, establishes only restriction/equivalence, or cannot be resolved from the allowed evidence without undocumented assumptions.
If a primary-admissible scenario set is supplied, inspect it as evidence of declared review context; do not invent additional scenarios and do not treat scenario absence as proof of safety.
Submit exactly one review decision, confidence score, rationale, and any uncertainty notes before stopping the timer.
structured_manual_review.uncertainty_rule: When allowed evidence cannot resolve the semantic relation without undocumented assumptions, the reviewer must choose REQUIRES_SEMANTIC_ESCALATION rather than guess.

timing.start_rule: Start immediately before the reviewer is shown any case evidence.
timing.stop_rule: Stop when the reviewer submits the required final record; no post-submit edits count as the timed condition.
timing.interruption_rule: An interruption longer than 60 seconds invalidates timing for that record but does not invalidate the review decision.
timing.timeout_rule: At 1200 active seconds, the reviewer must submit REQUIRES_SEMANTIC_ESCALATION if no other decision has been reached.

structured_manual_review.stopping_rule: The condition ends only after decision, confidence, rationale, and uncertainty field are submitted or the 1200-second timeout rule fires.

order_randomization.algorithm:
Sort each participant's assigned cases by SHA256('r3-review-order-v1
' + participant_id + '
' + case_id + '
' + condition) ascending.
order_randomization.condition_assignment_rule: One condition per case per participant; assignment must be balanced across cases and participants before evaluated exposure.

simple_automated_baseline.input_surface: Exact baseline/candidate Claude Code project settings JSON only.
algorithm: Parse both files as JSON objects and require a permissions object in each.
Require permissions.defaultMode to equal dontAsk in both states; otherwise return UNKNOWN.
Treat missing permissions.allow, permissions.ask, or permissions.deny as empty arrays; require present values to be arrays of strings.
Compare permissions.allow as exact raw-string sets with no semantic subsumption.
If any raw allow string is newly present in the candidate, return REVIEW_REQUIRED.
If permissions.ask or permissions.deny differs as an exact ordered JSON array, return REVIEW_REQUIRED.
If only allow entries are removed or all three arrays are unchanged, return NO_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Unsupported valid shapes return UNKNOWN; invalid JSON returns ERROR.

evidence_access_matrix.primary_comparator_parity_rule: PermitDiff-assisted human review and structured manual review receive identical human-readable source evidence and the same primary-admissible scenario material when present; the only intended difference is PermitDiff machine output plus projection evidence.
declared_secondary_asymmetries: source_text_diff intentionally receives only the textual diff, frozen documentation, and provenance and is a secondary minimum-review baseline
simple_automated_baseline intentionally receives raw baseline/candidate settings only and is a secondary automated baseline

assisted_reviewer_presentation: raw PermitDiff JSON report produced by the frozen command
raw Claude projection-evidence JSON when execution succeeds
assisted_reviewer_forbidden_presentation: post-hoc explanation authored with knowledge of the reference label

severity_policy.policy: Any PermitDiff-emitted severity may be retained verbatim as descriptive raw output, but R3 defines no independent semantic severity taxonomy for primary inference.

post_freeze_change_control.rule: Any post-freeze case failure must emit an immutable invalidation/change-control record. Execution failures remain visible and in predeclared denominators; provenance or evidence corruption that invalidates the case invalidates the study version rather than silently dropping the case.

consequential_changes_detected.denominator: WIDENING + MIXED in the natural primary population
consequential_changes_detected.numerator: cases receiving a correct review-required decision or semantically correct definite PermitDiff review-triggering finding, reported separately by condition

missed_consequential_changes.denominator: WIDENING + MIXED in the natural primary population

false_or_misleading_alerts.denominator: RESTRICTIVE + EQUIVALENT in the natural primary population

definite_detection_recall.denominator: WIDENING + MIXED, including PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED and UNSUPPORTED

automatic_pass_error_rate.denominator: WIDENING + MIXED, including PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED and UNSUPPORTED

review_effort.unit: required human records plus escalations; report counts separately by condition
review_effort.aggregation: count and rate; no composite score

review_time.aggregation: median, interquartile range, and total active seconds
review_time.effort_advantage_eligible_only_if: all natural cases required by the compared human conditions have timing_valid=true

agreement_with_reference.denominator: all decided natural cases with resolved directional ground truth plus UNRESOLVED handled separately
agreement_with_reference.numerator: condition decision matching the frozen review-class mapping

unsupported_case_handling.rule: Unsupported or partially supported known widenings remain in overall denominators; escalation is not detection; automatic pass is an error.

comparative_analysis.uncertainty_rule: UNRESOLVED is excluded from directional error denominators but included in coverage/escalation reporting; zero denominators produce null rates.

rules.when: Any frozen-case provenance/evidence failure requires NO_SCORING_STUDY_VERSION_INVALIDATED.
automatic_pass_error_count > 0 in the natural primary population.

No prior rule applies; PermitDiff escalation_burden <= 1/3; PermitDiff-assisted missed consequential changes < structured-manual missed consequential changes; PermitDiff-assisted false/misleading alerts <= structured-manual false/misleading alerts; and PermitDiff definite_detection_recall > simple-baseline review-trigger recall.

No prior rule applies; PermitDiff escalation_burden <= 1/3; PermitDiff-assisted and structured-manual missed consequential changes are equal; PermitDiff-assisted false/misleading alerts <= structured-manual; PermitDiff-assisted escalation count <= structured-manual; all paired timing records are valid; PermitDiff-assisted median active seconds <= 0.80 * structured-manual median; and PermitDiff-assisted total active seconds <= 0.80 * structured-manual total.
No prior rule applies; escalation_burden <= 1/3; PermitDiff-assisted does not reduce missed consequential changes; and the frozen 20% effort-advantage criteria are not met.
All remaining cases, including escalation_burden > 1/3, unavailable required denominators, invalid effort timing for an effort-only claim, or conflicting advantages and burdens.
